title: My voice memo recorded 8 hours 🎙️
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 2:02 in the morning, my voice memo app had a new recording.

scenes.narration: At 2:02 in the morning, my voice memo app had a new recording.
Eight hours long. Title, listen to this. I had never opened the app. I was awake, staring at it.
I pressed play. At first, only breathing. Slow. Mine. I recognized the rhythm of my own sleep.
At hour two, the breathing stopped. A floorboard creaked. Close to the microphone.
At hour three, a whisper. Too soft for words. Just a shape of sound, repeating.
I turned up the volume. It was saying my name. Over and over. Patiently. Like a lullaby.
At hour five, I heard myself talking in my sleep. I said, who is there?
And the whisper answered. In my own voice. The one who lets you sleep.
The recording kept going. I checked the clock on the screen. The recording was still running. It was live. Right now.
And in my headphones, very close, I heard a quiet voice say, thank you for listening. You can stop pretending to be awake.
So tell me. Do you press play again, or delete it?
